docs.title: ESS-DIVE Sample Data (Full) Lakehouse Schema
docs.text:
Warehouse-flavored (star-schema) LinkML schema for the ESS-DIVE Sample Data Reporting Format (Full), targeting a relational data lakehouse (Iceberg/Delta/Parquet).

This schema has a central Measurement fact class referencing the dimension classes Sample, MeasurementVariable, and Method by identifier (foreign key), plus a Dataset container holding the fact table and the variable "data dictionary" dimension.

URI: https://w3id.org/sierra-moxon/geochem-rf-linkml

Name: geochem-rf-linkml

docs.title: Classes
docs.text: Class Description Attribute A domain, measurement, attribute, property, or descriptor for something measured. The identity of what is measured (the "bare concept", e.g. temperature). Mirrors the BERtron/NMDC Attribute pattern: a thin data-dictionary anchor whose id is a controlled-vocabulary CURIE. MeasurementVariable A fully-qualified measured variable: the bare Attribute concept plus its unit and statistical/temporal qualifiers. One row of the ESS-DIVE Data Dictionary. This is the "variable dimension" of the star schema; the dimension business key is the qualified-identity tuple (see unique_keys), NOT the arbitrary user column name. Dataset A single ESS-DIVE sample-data package: the whole Measurement fact table plus the MeasurementVariable data-dictionary dimension (and the sample / method dimensions). Measurement A single measured value: the "fact" of the star schema. Points at a Sample and a MeasurementVariable (and optionally a Method) by identifier, and carries the actual measure(s). Method One row of the Full "Methods & Attributes" file (*_sample_attr.csv): the method/flag/treatment/sensor definition referenced per-measurement. Sample A physical sample (or a time point on a sample) that measurements are made on. The sample dimension of the star schema.

docs.text: Type Description Boolean A binary (true or false) value Curie a compact URI Date a date (year, month and day) in an idealized calendar DateOrDatetime Either a date or a datetime Datetime The combination of a date and time Decimal A real number with arbitrary precision that conforms to the xsd:decimal specification Double A real number that conforms to the xsd:double specification Float A real number that conforms to the xsd:float specification Integer An integer Jsonpath A string encoding a JSON Path. The value of the string MUST conform to JSON Point syntax and SHOULD dereference to zero or more valid objects within the current instance document when encoded in tree form. Jsonpointer A string encoding a JSON Pointer. The value of the string MUST conform to JSON Point syntax and SHOULD dereference to a valid object within the current instance document when encoded in tree form. Ncname Prefix part of CURIE Nodeidentifier A URI, CURIE or BNODE that represents a node in a model. Objectidentifier A URI or CURIE that represents an object in the model. Sparqlpath A string encoding a SPARQL Property Path. The value of the string MUST conform to SPARQL syntax and SHOULD dereference to zero or more valid objects within the current instance document when encoded as RDF. String A character string Time A time object represents a (local) time of day, independent of any particular day Uri a complete URI Uriorcurie a URI or a CURIE

docs.text:
The following diagram shows every class in the schema and the relationships between them.

erDiagram
Attribute {
    uriorcurie id  
    string label  
}
Dataset {
    uriorcurie id  
    string name  
}
Measurement {
    datetime datetime_measured  
    datetime datetime_value  
    stringList flag  
    float numeric_value  
    string raw_value  
    string string_value  
    float time_elapsed  
    string treatment_id  
}
MeasurementVariable {
    uriorcurie id  
    string column_or_row_long_name  
    string column_or_row_name  
    DataTypeEnum data_type  
    string definition  
    float lower_bound  
    string missing_value_code  
    RepresentationTemporalEnum representation_temporal  
    StatisticEnum statistic_measurement  
    StatisticEnum statistic_spatial  
    StatisticEnum statistic_temporal  
    UnitEnum unit  
    string unit_basis  
    uriorcurie unit_cv_id  
    float upper_bound  
    string label  
}
Method {
    float analysis_detection_limit  
    float analysis_precision  
    string attr_description  
    string attr_id  
    AttrTypeEnum attr_type  
    float instrument_precision  
    float lower_bound  
    string method_atmosphere  
    string method_hold_time  
    string method_instrument  
    string method_instrument_operator  
    string method_lab  
    string method_lab_contact  
    string method_light  
    string method_medium  
    string method_moisture  
    string method_reference  
    string method_temp  
    string method_time  
    float upper_bound  
}
Sample {
    datetime datetime_collected  
    float latitude  
    string location_description  
    float longitude  
    string sample_name  
}

Dataset ||--}o Measurement : "measurements"
Dataset ||--}o MeasurementVariable : "variables"
Dataset ||--}o Method : "methods"
Dataset ||--}o Sample : "samples"
Measurement ||--|| MeasurementVariable : "variable"
Measurement ||--|| Sample : "sample"
Measurement ||--}o Method : "method"

docs.text:
Use this folder to store templates to customize the generated model documentation. The templates are written in Jinja2 and are used to generate the HTML documentation for the schema.

The default templates are available in the linkml repository. If you want to use these as a starting point, you can copy them into this folder and modify them as needed.
